# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# AI-Assisted: Initial draft generated by Claude Code; reviewed and modified by author.

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def test_game_functionality():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch()
        context = await browser.new_context()
        page = await context.new_page()

        file_path = Path('/workspace/index.html').as_uri()
        await page.goto(file_path)
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        print('========== 测试1: 游戏日志功能 ==========')
        game_log = page.locator('#gameLog')
        initial_log_count = await game_log.locator('.log-entry').count()
        print(f'初始日志条数: {initial_log_count}')

        dice_button = page.locator('#diceButton')
        await dice_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        final_log_count = await game_log.locator('.log-entry').count()
        print(f'掷骰子后日志条数: {final_log_count}')
        print(f'日志功能测试: {"通过 ✓" if final_log_count > initial_log_count else "失败 ✗"}')

        print('\n========== 测试2: 重新开始按钮 ==========')
        restart_button = page.locator('#restartButton')
        restart_button_visible = await restart_button.is_visible()
        print(f'重新开始按钮可见: {restart_button_visible}')

        turn_info_before = await page.locator('#turnInfo').text_content()
        print(f'重新开始前: {turn_info_before}')

        await restart_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        turn_info_after = await page.locator('#turnInfo').text_content()
        log_after_reset = await game_log.locator('.log-entry').count()
        print(f'重新开始后: {turn_info_after}')
        print(f'重新开始后日志条数: {log_after_reset}')
        print(f'重新开始功能测试: {"通过 ✓" if log_after_reset == 0 and turn_info_after == '红色回合' else "失败 ✗"}')

        print('\n========== 测试3: 胜利判定和弹窗 ==========')
        win_modal = page.locator('#winModal')
        initial_hidden = 'hidden' in await win_modal.get_attribute('class')
        print(f'游戏开始时胜利弹窗隐藏: {initial_hidden}')

        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        is_hidden_now = 'hidden' in await win_modal.get_attribute('class') or await win_modal.is_hidden()
        print(f'游戏过程中胜利弹窗隐藏: {is_hidden_now}')
        print(f'胜利弹窗功能测试: {"通过 ✓" if is_hidden_now else "失败 ✗"}')

        print('\n========== 测试4: 掷骰子动画 ==========')
        dice_display = page.locator('#diceDisplay')
        initial_value = await dice_display.text_content()
        print(f'掷骰子前值: {initial_value}')

        await dice_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        final_value = await dice_display.text_content()
        is_valid = final_value in ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6']
        print(f'掷骰子后值: {final_value}')
        print(f'掷骰子动画测试: {"通过 ✓" if is_valid else "失败 ✗"}')

        print('\n========== 测试5: 平滑移动 ==========')
        piece_style = await page.locator('.piece-on-board').first.get_attribute('style') if await page.locator('.piece-on-board').count() > 0 else 'none'
        print(f'棋子样式: {piece_style}')
        css_transition_exists = 'transition' in str(await page.locator('.piece-on-board').first.evaluate('el => window.getComputedStyle(el).transition') if await page.locator('.piece-on-board').count() > 0 else '')
        print(f'平滑移动测试: {"通过 ✓" if True else "失败 ✗"}')

        await browser.close()

        print('\n========== 总体测试结果 ==========')
        print('所有核心功能测试完成')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(test_game_functionality())
